newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures closed for Japanese holiday.

text.p: The SIMEX Nikkei futures market was closed for a Japanese holiday on Thursday. Trading will resume on Friday.
On Wednesday, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 75 points below its previous settlement of 20,975, after covering a gap at 20,940 on the charts.
Dealers said the market looked set for further declines in the near future, but longer-term direction was likely to be determined by the outcome of the Japanese general elections on October 20.
A dealer with a Japanese institution said the December Nikkei faced resistance above 21,300 and was likely to come off further to 20,600.
